title: Utawarerumono: The Snow Road
alt: At sunrise two travelers stand on a snow slope above a valley. A woman with white animal ears and a long white tail points to a small village below. A man in a green robe follows her with a staff. Tall mountains catch pink light under a pale moon, and snow-covered fir trees stand on the right.
summary: A painting of a scene from Utawarerumono: Mask of Deception in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the beginning of Utawarerumono: Mask of Deception, a game by Aquaplus. A man wakes in the snow and remembers nothing. Kuon finds him, gives him the name Haku, and leads him down from the mountains.
The sun rises behind them. A village is in the valley below, and the moon is above the peaks. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
